claims: Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are twins.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to the Duke Blue Devils in 2024.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer's father is Carlos Boozer.
Cameron Boozer is a forward.
Cayden Boozer is a point guard.

Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born to serve as stem cell donors to save their older brother Carmani.

Carlos Boozer is a former NBA All-Star.

Carmani, older brother of Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer, was diagnosed with sickle cell disease.
Stem cells were collected from the umbilical cord blood of Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer at birth to cure their older brother Carmani.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were ranked high in the 2025 class.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer chose Duke over Miami and Florida.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are freshmen in the 2025-2026 season.

Carlos Boozer was a star player at Duke.
Carlos Boozer helped lead the Duke team to a National Championship in 2001.
